title: Forgotten Temple
description: (Legacy import from the original Saxum) Forgotten temple: You find yourself at the start of a Forgotten Temple: An ancient temple hidden in a mystical forest. There are strange alien artifacts around this place. It smells of sulfur and.. whiskey? The animals are cute but strange. The path ahead beckons with mystery and promise.

rooms.name: Temple Gate
rooms.description: Ancient stone structure, overgrown with vines, eerie green mist swirling around. Sulfur and whiskey scents fill the air. Cute, strange creatures flit about.

rooms.name: Grand Hall
rooms.description: High ceiling, filled with glittering crystals, reflecting flickering torchlight. Shadows dance across the floor. A grand, imposing atmosphere.

rooms.name: Dark Passage
rooms.description: Narrow, winding passage, darkness punctuated by faint, glowing mushrooms. Air thick with sulfur.

rooms.name: Winding Path
rooms.description: Narrow, winding path, lined with strange, glowing plants. Air filled with the scent of blooming flowers. Cute, strange creatures peek out from behind the foliage.

rooms.name: Mystery Room
rooms.description: Small, cozy room, filled with strange, alien artifacts. Whiskey scent strong here.

rooms.name: Chasm
rooms.description: Deep, yawning chasm, spanned by a rickety bridge. Wind whistles through the gap.

rooms.name: Clearing
rooms.description: Small, peaceful clearing, filled with a variety of strange, cute creatures. Sunlight filters through the trees.

rooms.name: Hidden Loft
rooms.description: Small, cozy loft, filled with strange, alien artifacts. Soft, whispery voice echoes through the space.

rooms.name: Chasm Floor
rooms.description: Rocky, barren floor of the chasm, lit by faint, glowing crystals. Air thick with the scent of damp earth.

rooms.name: Hidden Platform
rooms.description: Small, hidden platform, surrounded by a tangle of vines and flowers. Soft, warm breeze blows through the air.

npcs.name: Mystic Guardian
npcs.dialogue_seed:
[Quest Giver] Mystic Guardian is looking for something...
You don't have what they're looking for yet.
"Welcome, seeker of secrets"

items.name: Stone Pedestal
items.description: Carved stone pedestal, adorned with strange symbols

quests.title: Glowing Mushroom
quests.objective: Mystic Guardian at Temple Gate needs: Glowing Mushroom.

quests.title: Alien Orb
quests.objective: Curious Explorer at Mystery Room needs: Alien Orb.

quests.title: Alien Device
quests.objective: Temple Priest at Clearing needs: Alien Device.
